name: Quest Work Shown
description: How a Quest user sees what their AI is doing: first beats, steps for a turn that cannot finish yet, progress while work runs, the explanation of an answer and the trace of the work.
purpose: Let a person see what their AI is doing for them and what an answer rests on.
approach: Show events by the mode the person is in, from the structure of the turn, and keep private titles out of shared team threads.
out_of_scope: Deciding what to do (Mind); checking what a reply claims about the account (Quest Account Truth).
milestones: 1. One balanced number covers narration, steps, progress, explanation and the work trace on Quest turns.
measures_of_success: One balanced number over turn events, long runs and private titles in shared team threads: what is shown matches what the mode defines and what happened.
parameters: The mode a person is in and the length of a first beat.
inputs: The events of a turn or run.
outputs: First beats, steps, progress lines, an explanation and a work trace.
effects: Messages to the person; one model call for narration and one for an explanation.
usage_notes: Shown beside the reply in chat and as milestones in the background.
